title: Team view · never shown to the prospect

verdicts.high: High priority. Invite to Phase 2 and offer a results review call.
verdicts.nurture: Nurture. High need and potential, readiness unclear. Phase 2 should confirm budget and decision-maker.
verdicts.prepare: Prepare first. Real problems, but volume or deal value may not justify a full build yet.
verdicts.selective: Selective optimization. Sell one targeted improvement, not a full system.
verdicts.low: Low fit for now. Keep in a light nurture sequence.

openingLine: “Your X-ray says {archetype}. Can I show you the one fix I'd start with?”

login.title: Team sign-in
login.sub: We'll email you a one-time sign-in link. Only approved team addresses get one.
login.label: Work email
login.sent: If {email} is on the team list, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it in this browser.
login.errorLink: That sign-in link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
login.errorDenied: That account doesn't have access to this dashboard.
login.errorSend: We couldn't send the link. Wait a minute and try again.

list.title: Leads
list.empty: No companies yet. Create one to get an access code.

detail.teamPending: The team view appears once the lead answers at least one question.
detail.noGift: No gift offered yet. It's offered once the lead has an email and finishes Phase 1.

form.title: New company
form.sub: Creates the company and a unique access code you can send by email.
form.name: Business name
form.langNote: The language the link opens in. The prospect can switch with the EN / ES button. Write the outside view below in this language.
form.outsideTitle: What we saw from the outside (optional)
form.outsideSub: Shown on the welcome screen. Fill in every field or leave them all empty. Use only real, honest observations.

outsidePlaceholders.text: We texted your listed number at 8:42 p.m. asking about…
outsidePlaceholders.reply: First reply: next day at 11:20 a.m.

form.errorGeneric: Please fix the fields marked below.

preview.title: Diagnostic preview
preview.sub: Every Phase 1 screen exactly as a prospect sees it, at phone width (400 px). Nothing on this page or in the walkthrough is saved.
preview.langNote: Switches the language of every screen below and of the walkthrough in this browser.
preview.trySub: Opens the real flow with a preview code. Answers live only in that tab, are never saved, and a bar at the bottom lets you jump to any question or load sample results.

screens.report: Read-only report (/r) · link in the results email

preview.mapSub: In order. Question screens use a business without a known industry, so the industry question appears too; with a code that includes the industry it's skipped.
preview.autoAdvance: No insight → advances on its own
preview.multiNote: No insight · multi-select, waits for Continue
preview.calcNote: No insight · the dollar figure updates live as the sliders move. Shown with the Leaky Bucket sample answers.
preview.archetypesSub: Results rendered from a sample set of answers, next to the team view the prospect never sees.
